checklist.text: A feather per species (Ember Plume, Dusk Down, Gild Quill, Rime Feather, plus Designer ones)
Drops, drift and click to collect
Counts per species in the HUD, saved
No coin left anywhere (HUD, log lines, pedestal, store text)
Smoke test (qa-plan.md section 3; buying now spends feathers)
Birds drop feathers in their own color; they float down swaying and lie flat
Click a feather: it vanishes, the log says it was collected and the HUD count goes up
The HUD collection fills in as you collect; hover shows the feather's name; nothing overlaps the dial
The pedestal's right window reads FEATHERS with the total
Store: Buy spends feathers (any kind, biggest stack first); the tag and log say when short
Quit and relaunch: counts and loose feathers come back; an old save loads with zero feathers
Tools panel: Feathers sliders and the "+10 of each feather" cheat work
The rustle and tick sounds are fine as placeholders
Income feels right (store about 3x pricier until 13b-2)
Optional: delete the empty Coin.cs and the unused coin_land.wav and coin_pickup.wav

description: Feathers replace coins. A full meal drops a feather of the bird's own species (0.22 a meal, regulars and named birds 1.5x): Ember Plume, Dusk Down, Gild Quill, Rime Feather, and "<Name> Feather" for Designer species. It pops, floats down swaying, lies flat in the species' color for 60 s (half that out of view). Counts are per species, saved; the right column shows a collection grid (a species appears after its first feather; hover for the name) and the pedestal window reads FEATHERS with the total. The store still has its old prices and takes feathers of any kind, biggest stack first, until 13b-2. Old saves' coins are reset to zero. New soft placeholder sounds. Session 39. Compiled and run in Claude's workspace (drops, drift, collect, spend, save and load, old-format save); not yet run on your machine.
title: 5.14 Step 13b-1: Feathers drop and are counted
